title: veronica ovata var. japonica
intro: Veronica ovata var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese speedwell, is a plant species that belongs to the Plantaginaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese speedwell include wound healing, anti-aging, and immunomodulation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
